sample.task: Write a closure notice for a Greggs on Sauchiehall Street, saying that this store has now closed, and directing patrons to the new one just across from Costa, saying "It's just across the street from the Costa next to Henrik's (fictional department store from Doctor Who)"
sample.chosen:
**Closure Notice**

Dear Valued Customers,

We regret to inform you that our Greggs store located at 123 Sauchiehall Street has now closed its doors. We have thoroughly enjoyed serving you and the local community over the years, and we appreciate your continued support.

We are excited to announce that we have a new store just a short distance away, conveniently located just across the street from the Costa Coffee, next to Henrik's Department Store. Here are the new store details:

**New Greggs Store**
456 Sauchiehall Street
Glasgow, G2 3JZ

We look forward to welcoming you at our new location, where you can continue to enjoy your favourite Greggs treats and pastries. Thank you for your understanding and we hope to see you soon!

Best regards,

The Greggs Team
sample.rejected:
Title: Notice of Temporary Closure at Greggs, Sauchiehall Street

Dear Valued Customers,

We regret to inform you that our Greggs store located on Sauchiehall Street will be temporarily closed for renovations. We understand this may cause some inconvenience, and we sincerely apologize for any disruption this may cause to your daily routines.

We are pleased to announce that our new store will be opening soon, just across the street from the Costa Coffee shop, next to Henrik's (fictional department store from Doctor Who). This new location will offer the same delicious range of sausage rolls, steak bakes, and other baked goods you've come to love.

We appreciate your continued support and patience during this transition period. Our team is working diligently to ensure the new store is ready to serve you as soon as possible.

Thank you for choosing Greggs, and we look forward to welcoming you at our new location soon!

Best Regards,

The Greggs Team
